[NTST.13.4] **One driver per runtime.** pyds, @ds-lang/ds and mercury_ds **must**
each expose `ds_test_run` and its report ([NTST.13.2]). dsdb **must** run a
program's tests through that entry point and through no driver of its own, so a
test passes or fails by the runtime's verdict wherever it is run.
